<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { createEventDispatcher } from 'svelte';

  interface Ball {
    x: number;
    y: number;
    vx: number;
    vy: number;
    radius: number;
  }

  let { ballCount = 5, isPaused = false }: { ballCount: number; isPaused: boolean } = $props();

  const dispatch = createEventDispatcher();

  const CANVAS_WIDTH = 400;
  const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 300;
  const BALL_RADIUS = 10;
  const GRAVITY = 0.2;

  let canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  let ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D;
  let balls: Ball[] = $state([]);
  let animationId: number;

  function createBall(): Ball {
    return {
      x: Math.random() * (CANVAS_WIDTH - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
      y: Math.random() * (CANVAS_HEIGHT - 2 * BALL_RADIUS) + BALL_RADIUS,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      radius: BALL_RADIUS,
    };
  }

  function initializeBalls(count: number) {
    balls = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      balls.push(createBall());
    }
  }

  function updateBalls() {
    // Apply gravity
    for (let ball of balls) {
      ball.vy += GRAVITY;
    }

    // Update positions
    for (let ball of balls) {
      ball.x += ball.vx;
      ball.y += ball.vy;
    }

    // Check collisions with walls
    for (let ball of balls) {
      // Left and right walls
      if (ball.x - ball.radius < 0) {
        ball.x = ball.radius;
        ball.vx = -ball.vx;
      }
      if (ball.x + ball.radius > CANVAS_WIDTH) {
        ball.x = CANVAS_WIDTH - ball.radius;
        ball.vx = -ball.vx;
      }

      // Top and bottom walls
      if (ball.y - ball.radius < 0) {
        ball.y = ball.radius;
        ball.vy = -ball.vy;
      }
      if (ball.y + ball.radius > CANVAS_HEIGHT) {
        ball.y = CANVAS_HEIGHT - ball.radius;
        ball.vy = -ball.vy;
      }
    }

    // Check collisions between balls
    for (let i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < balls.length; j++) {
        const ball1 = balls[i];
        const ball2 = balls[j];

        const dx = ball2.x - ball1.x;
        const dy = ball2.y - ball1.y;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const minDistance = ball1.radius + ball2.radius;

        if (distance < minDistance) {
          // Exchange velocities (elastic collision with equal mass)
          const tempVx = ball1.vx;
          const tempVy = ball1.vy;
          ball1.vx = ball2.vx;
          ball1.vy = ball2.vy;
          ball2.vx = tempVx;
          ball2.vy = tempVy;

          // Separate balls to prevent overlap
          const overlap = minDistance - distance;
          const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
          const separation = overlap / 2 + 0.5;
          ball1.x -= Math.cos(angle) * separation;
          ball1.y -= Math.sin(angle) * separation;
          ball2.x += Math.cos(angle) * separation;
          ball2.y += Math.sin(angle) * separation;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#444';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, CANVAS_WIDTH, CANVAS_HEIGHT);

    for (let ball of balls) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function animate() {
    if (!isPaused) {
      updateBalls();
      dispatch('frameupdate');
    }

    draw();
    animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  onMount(() => {
    ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    initializeBalls(ballCount);
    animate();

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
    };
  });

  $effect(() => {
    if (balls.length < ballCount) {
      balls.push(createBall());
    }
  });
</script>

/>

          balls[i].x -= Math.cos(angle) * separation;
          balls[i].y -= Math.sin(angle) * separation;
          balls[j].x += Math.cos(angle) * separation;
          balls[j].y += Math.sin(angle) * separation;
        }
      }
    }

        ball.x = ball.radius;
        ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);

        ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);

        ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
      if (ball.y + ball.radius > height) {
        ball.y = height - ball.radius;
        ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
    }

    frameCount++;
    onFrameUpdate(frameCount);

    for (let ball of balls) {

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

    draw();
    animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

    ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    balls = createBalls(initialBalls);
    lastInitialBalls = initialBalls;
    animate();

    return () => {
      if (animationId !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
      }
    };
  });

  $effect(() => {

      balls = createBalls(initialBalls);
      lastInitialBalls = initialBalls;
      frameCount = 0;
      onFrameUpdate(frameCount);
